title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
“这个……”宁轻眉似乎有些纠结，柳眉皱了起来，但最终还是摇了摇头：“让我再考虑一下吧！”“那好，如果你有需要，随时找我！”接着，陈青云又关心了几句，为她削了个苹果，随后离开病房。望着他的背影，宁轻眉眼神复杂，掏出手机打给了闺蜜萧云妃。“云妃，如果有人能治好我的特殊体质，你说要不要试试？”宁轻眉问道。因为这特殊之处，她一直有些自卑。结婚之日，身居高位的丈夫发现了她的秘密，竟然因为“白虎克夫”的传闻，而没有碰她。不久后，她丈夫又生了一场大病，身子越来越虚弱，更加害怕，结婚几年都没和她同房过。最近，丈夫更是生怕诅咒成真，把她调到了县城。陈青云被发配到水库，而她来到松山县，又何尝不是如此？“难道你找到了京城的御医么？”萧云妃惊喜问道。“不是，是陈青云！”宁轻眉回答道。“他怎么知道你是白虎……难道他看过了？”萧云妃立刻发现了盲点，语气变得有些古怪。“这个……”宁轻眉一时不知该如何回答，俏脸泛红，连忙转移话题：“这个你就别管了！”“反正试试，你也没有损失啊，不过他要怎么帮你治疗啊？”萧云妃问道。听到这个问题，宁轻眉心中害羞，但还是开口道：“他说可以用祖传的手法，替我按摩那儿……”“什么？！”电话那头，萧云妃也大吃一惊：“你昨天还说陈青云老实，没想到这么色，早就在打你的主意了！不过他可是个大帅哥，又比你年轻几岁，真要发生什么，还是你占便宜呢！”“呸，你胡说什么呢？”宁轻眉咬着樱唇，心中纠结无比。“我的大小姐，你就别烦恼了！也许陈青云就是你的贵人，能治好你的病！”“就算不行，他至少能让你体会一下当女人的滋味，你总不能守一辈子活寡吧？”“到时候，咱们仨一起，我帮你们加油鼓劲！”宁轻眉受不了闺蜜的胡话，立刻挂断电话，却觉得心脏一阵怦怦直跳。她的脑海中，不由自主浮现出陈青云的身影，一时有些醉了。

……周一，陈青云回到县政府办上班。戴斌见了他，不复之前的嚣张，灰溜溜的低着头。毕竟，他刚被狠狠打脸，甚至还写了三千字的检讨书。但他想破脑袋都不明白，陈青云是怎么抱上杨副县长的大腿。“哒哒哒！”没过多久，一个美少妇踩着高跟鞋，走进秘书科。看到她，陈青云眼睛一亮。正是政府办副主任，高露。今天她穿着灰色西装，里面是白色衬衫，包裹着挺拔的酥胸，罩罩又是黑色的，隐隐能看到若隐若现的花纹。她的脸不算绝美，但很有韵味，搭配着金框眼镜，总是一副高高在上、盛气凌人的样子。但陈青云却知道，高露十分反差，这高冷正经的外表之下，其实拥有一颗风骚的心。他手机里，还有许多高露放给杨天明的私密照，那叫一个带劲！若是有机会，他也想尝尝这个高冷女上司的滋味！“陈秘书，新县长来了，喊你过去一趟，就在之前唐县长的办公室！”高露开口道。“好，我马上去！”陈青云立刻起身，走出办公室。“嘿嘿！”望着他的背影，戴斌却一脸坏笑，幸灾乐祸。“这小子以为抱上了杨副县长的大腿，就能高枕无忧么？一朝天子一朝臣，现在新县长来了，他只有坐冷板凳的份儿！”在官场上，秘书和司机是领导身边最亲近的，一荣俱荣一损俱损，必须是信得过的人。陈青云作为老县长的秘书，绝不可能受到新县长的重用。很快，陈青云走到县长办公室门口，深呼一口气，敲了敲门。“县长，我是陈青云，向您汇报！”他隔着门喊道，心中却有些忐忑。对于这位市里派来的新县长，他还一无所知。只知道她是个女的，才30岁，如此年轻的女干部，绝对有天大的背景，估计是来下面镀金的。

"This..." Ning Qingmei seemed a little tangled, her eyebrows furrowed, but she finally shook her head: "Let me think about it again!" "Well, if you need anything, come to me anytime!" Then, Chen Qingyun expressed some concern, peeled an apple for her, and then left the ward.Looking at his back, Ning Qingqing's eyes were complicated, and she took out her mobile phone and called her best friend Xiao Yunfei."Fei Yun, if someone can cure my special constitution, do you want to try it?" Ning Qingmei asked.Because of this special feature, she has always felt inferior.On the wedding day, her husband, who was in a high position, discovered her secret, but he did not touch her because of the rumors of "White Tiger Kefu".Not long after, her husband fell ill again and became increasingly frail and frightened. He did not have sex with her for several years after they were married.Recently, her husband was afraid that the curse would come true, so he transferred her to the county seat.Chen Qingyun was assigned to the reservoir, and when she came to Songshan County, why was it not the same?"Have you found the imperial doctor in the capital?" Concubine Xiao Yun asked in surprise."No, it's Chen Qingyun!" Ning Qingmei replied."How did he know you were the White Tiger...Has he seen it before?" Concubine Xiao Yun immediately discovered the blind spot and her tone became a little weird."This..." Ning Qingmei didn't know how to answer for a moment, her pretty face flushed, and she quickly changed the subject: "Don't worry about this!" "Anyway, you won't lose if you try it, but how will he help you treat it?" Concubine Xiao Yun asked.Hearing this question, Ning Qingmei felt shy, but she still said: "He said he could use ancestral techniques to massage that place for me..." "What?!" Concubine Xiao Yun was also shocked on the other end of the phone: "You said yesterday that Chen Qingyun was honest, but you didn'tThinking of being so lustful, I've been planning on you for a long time!But he's a handsome guy and he's a few years younger than you.What's going to happen, you're going to take advantage!" "Bah, what are you talking about?" Ning Qingmei bit her lips, feeling extremely confused."My eldest lady, don't worry! Maybe Chen Qingyun is your noble man and can cure your disease!" "Even if it doesn't work, he can at least let you experience what it's like to be a woman. You can't stay a widow for the rest of your life, right?" "Then, the three of us will be together, and I will cheer you up!" Ning Qingmei couldn't stand the nonsense of her best friend, and immediately hung up the phone, but felt her heart pounding.Chen Qingyun's figure appeared in her mind involuntarily, and she was a little drunk for a moment.

...On Monday, Chen Qingyun returned to work at the county government office.When Dai Bin saw him, he was no longer as arrogant as before and lowered his head dejectedly.After all, he had just been slapped in the face so hard that he even wrote a three-thousand-word letter of apology.But even if he thought about it, he couldn't figure out how Chen Qingyun got into Deputy County Magistrate Yang's lap."Da da da!" Not long after, a beautiful young woman walked into the secretarial department on high heels.Seeing her, Chen Qingyun's eyes lit up.It was Gao Lu, deputy director of the Government Office.Today she was wearing a gray suit with a white shirt underneath, covering her tall and firm breasts. The bra was black, and the looming patterns could be seen faintly.Her face is not beautiful, but it is very charming. With gold-rimmed glasses, she always looks aloof and domineering.But Chen Qingyun knew that Gao Lu was very different. Under this cold and serious appearance, he actually had a coquettish heart.In his mobile phone, there are many private photos that Gao Lu showed to Yang Tianming, which is very exciting!If given the chance, he would also like to have a taste of this cold female boss!"Secretary Chen, the new county magistrate is here. I want you to come over. It's in Magistrate Tang's office!" Gao Lu said."Okay, I'll go right away!" Chen Qingyun immediately stood up and walked out of the office."Hehe!" Looking at his back, Dai Bin had a smirk on his face, gloating about his misfortune."Does this kid think that he can sit back and relax by hugging Deputy County Magistrate Yang's lap? Once the emperor, he was once a courtier, and now that the new county magistrate is here, he can only sit on the bench!" In the officialdom, secretaries and drivers are the closest people to the leader, and they must be trustworthy people.As the secretary of the old county magistrate, Chen Qingyun would never be reused by the new county magistrate.Soon, Chen Qingyun walked to the door of the county magistrate's office, took a deep breath, and knocked on the door."County Magistrate, I am Chen Qingyun, reporting to you!" He shouted through the door, but felt a little uneasy in his heart.He still knew nothing about the new county magistrate sent by the city.All I know is that she is a woman, only 30 years old. Such a young female cadre must have a great background, and she probably came here to get gold.
